name: isometric wrist extension
description: A static hold where you press the back of your hand upward against resistance. It strengthens the wrist extensors without moving the joint.
instructions: Sit with your forearm resting on a table, palm down and wrist at the edge.
Place your other hand on top of the working hand.
Try to lift the hand up while the top hand resists.
Hold for 5-10 seconds with no movement.
